Print Receipt

Motionby @jeetnirnejak2026-08-24inspora pageoriginal post

What it is

Print Receipt: an 'Order ready' card whose 'Print receipt' button makes a paper receipt physically emerge from the bottom of the card - the paper grows downward line by line (store header, items, totals, QR code) like a thermal printer, then a 'Tear off' action detaches it with a slight tilt.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-18%
Card 'Receipt #6071': receipt icon, 'Order ready', order summary line, black 'Print receipt' button; caption 'Tap print to receive the receipt'.
18-30%
Button pressed: caption changes to 'Printing...'; a white paper strip slides out from under the card, 8px at first, jagged none.
30-60%
Paper extends progressively: 'BLUE TOKAI COFFEE' header types in, then address lines, item rows with prices, subtotal/tax/total - content appears top-down as the paper grows (clip-masked reveal).
60-85%
Full receipt hangs below: Thank-you line, 'SCAN TO PAY UPI', QR code; header button becomes 'Tear off'; 'printing 3/14' progress indicator during growth.
85-100%
Tear off: receipt detaches with a slight rotate and drop-fade; card resets.

Mechanics

trigger
Print receipt click; Tear off click
elements
order card, paper strip (height-animated, clip-masked), receipt content (staggered lines), progress indicator
properties
paper height, content clip reveal top-down, line-by-line opacity, tear-off rotate + translateY + fade
timing
print ~2.5s total, lines stagger ~120ms; tear 350ms
easing
linear paper feed with tiny jitter steps (thermal printer feel); ease-in tear drop
loop
no

Build prompt

Build a print-receipt microinteraction. Card 280px, white, radius 12, header 'Receipt #6071' + status; body: centered receipt icon, 'Order ready' (16px semibold), muted order line, black 'Print receipt' pill. On print: button caption swaps to an inline spinner + 'Printing', and a 240px-wide paper strip (white, subtle top shadow, zigzag bottom edge via clip-path) begins growing from beneath the card - animate its height in small stepped increments (3-4px per 80ms tick, not smooth, to feel like a thermal feed) while a 'printing N/14' counter advances. Receipt content (monospace-ish: store name bold centered, address, dotted-leader item rows, subtotal/tax/total, thank-you, QR image) is revealed by the paper's clip mask top-down, each line fading in as the mask passes it (so text never appears before paper). Fully printed: header button becomes 'Tear off'; clicking it detaches the paper - rotate -4deg, translateY +40px, fade to 0 over 350ms ease-in - and the card returns to 'Order ready'.
Source: inspora.design - original interaction by @jeetnirnejak. Teardown snapshot Sep 2026.
